question: how should the evidence chain be re-checked, given that one level needs the network

split.claim_level: local and deterministic, so it runs on every validation: each locator file digest and the excerpt hash at its recorded line range
split.byte_level: requires re-fetching archives, so it is run on request and its recorded result is checked here for staleness rather than repeated

why_not_run_the_network_check_in_the_gat: a gate that reaches the network is not deterministic and would fail for reasons unrelated to the work being validated, which is how a gate becomes something people disable
staleness_contract: the byte-level receipt records the digest of the claim locator file it was run against; when that file changes the recorded result no longer applies and the gate fails

errors: claim locator file or excerpt no longer verifies

failing_first_tests.mutation: append a locator so the evidence base changes
